notes.title: Shooting experience update
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players!

Here comes the new update.

This update focuses on the combat (shooting) part of the game. The goal is to make everyone have a smoother and refreshing combat experience. The contents of this update are as follows:

1、 Tiger wasp shooting feel Optimization: including Gu Jiuxun’s "Tiger Wasp", EA special weapon "Spirit Spider", Miao Mo's pistol, so as to make them have better shooting accuracy and feedback.

2、 Submachine gun shooting feel Optimization: the effect is the same as above.

3、 Grandpa's beloved baby "Sarah Jean" shooting feel Optimization: Sarah Jean 's range and power are enhanced to a certain extent, making it easier to burst heads, cause damage and hard straight effect to monsters, and better match the power setting of "shotgun".

4、 Optimized shooting feel of quantum jammer: longer range.

5、 Monster overall logic optimization: the monster has more hard straight actions, and the hard straight time will be extended appropriately.

7、	At the same time, new filter effects are added: we provide six filters: normal, pale blue, deep red, dark green and black-and-white. After entering the game, you can click "ESC" to enter the "pause menu" for selection. The picture effect is as follows:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38272519/d551d459dde5b11fbeb7f9c2290446bd9f4b74f8.jpg[/img]

Wish all of players will enjoy this version!
